/* selectUserJoinCount_backup - Lee JiSeob */
SELECT
COUNT(*) AS CNT
FROM (
SELECT D.USER_ID FROM SCA100 C /* 종사자 */ JOIN SAA200 D /* 사용자 */ ON D.ENFSN_NO = C.ENFSN_NO JOIN SAB230 DF /* 사용자기관 */ ON DF.USER_ID = D.USER_ID
AND D.USER_ID LIKE '%' || #{SEARCH_VALUE} || '%'
AND C.FLNM_ENCPT = #{SEARCH_VALUE_ENCPT}
AND D.JOIN_APLY_DT >= TO_DATE(#{APPLY_START_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND D.JOIN_APLY_DT <= TO_DATE(#{APPLY_END_DATE} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND 1=1
AND 1=2
AND D.USER_ID_USE_SE_CD = #{USER_ID_USE_SE_CD}
AND DF.MAIST_YN = 'Y'
UNION ALL
SELECT F.USER_ID FROM SAA000 E /* 기관 */ JOIN SAB230 EF /* 사용자기관 */ ON EF.INST_NO = E.INST_NO JOIN SAA200 F /* 사용자 */ ON F.USER_ID = EF.USER_ID
AND F.USER_ID LIKE '%' || #{SEARCH_VALUE} || '%'
AND E.INST_NM = #{SEARCH_VALUE}
AND F.JOIN_APLY_DT >= TO_DATE(#{APPLY_START_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND F.JOIN_APLY_DT <= TO_DATE(#{APPLY_END_DATE} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND 1=1
AND 1=2
AND F.USER_ID_USE_SE_CD = #{USER_ID_USE_SE_CD}
AND EF.MAIST_YN = 'Y'
UNION ALL
SELECT H.USER_ID FROM SCA200 G /* 청소년 보호자 */ JOIN SAA200 H /* 사용자 */ ON H.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO = G.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO
AND H.USER_ID LIKE '%' || #{SEARCH_VALUE} || '%'
AND G.FLNM_ENCPT = #{SEARCH_VALUE_ENCPT}
AND H.JOIN_APLY_DT >= TO_DATE(#{APPLY_START_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND H.JOIN_APLY_DT <= TO_DATE(#{APPLY_END_DATE} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND G.YNGBGS_PRTCR_SE_CD = 'Y'
AND G.YNGBGS_PRTCR_SE_CD = 'G'
AND 1=2
AND H.USER_ID_USE_SE_CD = #{USER_ID_USE_SE_CD}
) X

/* selectUserJoin - Lee JiSeob */
SELECT
X.USER_ID, X.USER_NM, X.USER_ID_USE_SE_CD, X.USER_ID_USE_SE_NM, X.USER_TYPE, X.USER_TYPE_NM, TO_CHAR(X.JOIN_APLY_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS JOIN_APLY_DT
FROM (
SELECT D.USER_ID, C.FLNM_ENCPT AS USER_NM, D.USER_ID_USE_SE_CD, (SELECT G.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 G /* 공통코드 값 */ WHERE G.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'USER_ID_USE_SE_CD' AND G.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = D.USER_ID_USE_SE_CD) AS USER_ID_USE_SE_NM, 'WORKER' AS USER_TYPE, '종사자' AS USER_TYPE_NM, D.JOIN_APLY_DT FROM SCA100 C /* 종사자 */ JOIN SAA200 D /* 사용자 */ ON D.ENFSN_NO = C.ENFSN_NO
AND D.USER_ID LIKE '%' || #{SEARCH_VALUE} || '%'
AND C.FLNM_ENCPT = #{SEARCH_VALUE_ENCPT}
AND D.JOIN_APLY_DT >= TO_DATE(#{APPLY_START_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND D.JOIN_APLY_DT <= TO_DATE(#{APPLY_END_DATE} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND 1=1
AND 1=2
AND D.USER_ID_USE_SE_CD = #{USER_ID_USE_SE_CD}
UNION ALL
SELECT F.USER_ID, '____' || E.INST_NM AS USER_NM, F.USER_ID_USE_SE_CD, (SELECT H.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 H /* 공통코드 값 */ WHERE H.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'USER_ID_USE_SE_CD' AND H.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = F.USER_ID_USE_SE_CD) AS USER_ID_USE_SE_NM, 'INSTITUTE' AS USER_TYPE, '기관' AS USER_TYPE_NM, F.JOIN_APLY_DT FROM SAA000 E /* 기관 */ JOIN SAB230 FE /* 사용자기관 */ ON FE.INST_NO = E.INST_NO JOIN SAA200 F /* 사용자 */ ON F.USER_ID = FE.USER_ID
AND F.USER_ID LIKE '%' || #{SEARCH_VALUE} || '%'
AND E.INST_NM = #{SEARCH_VALUE}
AND F.JOIN_APLY_DT >= TO_DATE(#{APPLY_START_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND F.JOIN_APLY_DT <= TO_DATE(#{APPLY_END_DATE} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND 1=1
AND 1=2
AND F.USER_ID_USE_SE_CD = #{USER_ID_USE_SE_CD}
UNION ALL
SELECT H.USER_ID, G.FLNM_ENCPT AS USER_NM, H.USER_ID_USE_SE_CD, (SELECT I.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 I /* 공통코드 값 */ WHERE I.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'USER_ID_USE_SE_CD' AND I.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = H.USER_ID_USE_SE_CD) AS USER_ID_USE_SE_NM, CASE WHEN G.YNGBGS_PRTCR_SE_CD = 'G' THEN 'GUARDIAN' ELSE 'YOUTH' END AS USER_TYPE, CASE WHEN G.YNGBGS_PRTCR_SE_CD = 'G' THEN '보호자' ELSE '청소년' END AS USER_TYPE_NM, H.JOIN_APLY_DT FROM SCA200 G /* 청소년 보호자 */ JOIN SAA200 H /* 사용자 */ ON H.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO = G.YNGBGS_PRTCR_NO
AND H.USER_ID LIKE '%' || #{SEARCH_VALUE} || '%'
AND G.FLNM_ENCPT = #{SEARCH_VALUE_ENCPT}
AND H.JOIN_APLY_DT >= TO_DATE(#{APPLY_START_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND H.JOIN_APLY_DT <= TO_DATE(#{APPLY_END_DATE} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND G.YNGBGS_PRTCR_SE_CD = 'Y'
AND G.YNGBGS_PRTCR_SE_CD = 'G'
AND 1=2
AND H.USER_ID_USE_SE_CD = #{USER_ID_USE_SE_CD}
) X
ORDER BY X.JOIN_APLY_DT DESC, X.USER_ID ASC, X.USER_TYPE ASC
OFFSET #{OFFSET_IDX} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{ROW_COUNT} ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: /* SQL-ID : isry.itgcms.sysmgmt.userjoin.mapper.ApproveUserJoinMapper.updateWorkerInfoByUserJoin : 종사자 정보 수정 (회원가입승인) */ UPDATE SCA100 /** 종사자 */ SET ENFSN_ROLE_SE_CD = #{ENFSN_ROLE_SE_CD}, LAST_MDFR_ID = #{LAST_MDFR_ID}, LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE WHERE ENFSN_NO = #{ENFSN_NO} /* 종사자번호 */
mapper.select: SELECT /* SQL-ID : isry.itgcms.sysmgmt.userjoin.mapper.ApproveUserJoinMapper.selectUserAuthInfo : 사용자 권한 정보 조회 (회원가입승인 팝업) */ U.USER_ID /* 사용자아이디 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(W.FLNM_ENCPT) AS USER_FLNM /* 사용자성명 */ , I.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD /* 단위업무구분코드 */ , W.OGDP_INST_NO /* 소속기관번호 */ , CASE WHEN (W.OGDP_INST_NO = 0 OR W.OGDP_INST_NO IS NULL) THEN '' ELSE I.INST_NM END AS OGDP_INST_NM /* 소속기관명 */ , I.INST_TYPE_SE_CD /* 기관유형구분코드 */ , CASE WHEN I.INST_TYPE_SE_CD IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ( SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'INST_TYPE_SE_CD' /* 공통코드아이디 */ AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = I.INST_TYPE_SE_CD /* 기관유형구분코드 */ AND USE_YN = 'Y' /* 공통코드_사용여부 */ ) END AS INST_TYPE_SE_NM /* 기관유형구분명 */ , W.PRVUSE_JOIN_SE_CD /* 전용가입구분코드 */ , CASE WHEN W.PRVUSE_JOIN_SE_CD IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ( SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'PRVUSE_JOIN_SE_CD' /* 공통코드아이디 */ AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = W.PRVUSE_JOIN_SE_CD /* 전용가입구분코드 */ AND USE_YN = 'Y' /* 공통코드_사용여부 */ ) END AS PRVUSE_JOIN_SE_NM /* 전용가입구분명 */ , A.GROUP_AUTHRT_SE_CD /* 그룹권한구분코드 */ , A.AUTHRT_SE_CD /* 권한구분코드 */ FROM SAA200 U /** 사용자 */ , SCA100 W /** 종사자 */ , SAA000 I /** 통합기관 */ , SAB230 A /** 사용자별 기관 권한 */ WHERE 1=1 AND U.ENFSN_NO = W.ENFSN_NO /* SCA100: 종사자번호 */ AND W.OGDP_INST_NO = I.INST_NO /* SCA100: 기관번호 */ AND U.USER_ID = A.USER_ID /* SAB230: 사용자아이디 */ AND I.INST_NO = A.INST_NO /* SAB230: 기관번호 */ AND U.USER_ID = #{USER_ID} /* 사용자아이디 */
mapper.update: /* SQL-ID : isry.itgcms.sysmgmt.userjoin.mapper.ApproveUserJoinMapper.updateUserInstAuthrtByUserJoin : 기관 권한 업데이트 (회원가입승인) */ UPDATE SAB230 /** 사용자별 기관 권한 */ SET GROUP_AUTHRT_SE_CD = #{GROUP_AUTHRT_SE_CD} /* 그룹권한구분코드 */ , AUTHRT_SE_CD = #{AUTHRT_SE_CD} /* 권한구분코드 */ , LAST_MDFR_ID = #{LAST_MDFR_ID} /* 최종수정자아이디 */ , LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE /* 최종수정일시 */ WHERE 1=1 AND USER_ID = #{USER_ID} /* 사용자아이디 */ AND INST_NO = #{OGDP_INST_NO} /* 소속기관번호 (주기관) */

/* selectUserJoinInfo - Lee JiSeob */
SELECT
C.USER_ID,
TO_CHAR(C.JOIN_APLY_DT, 'YYYY') || '년 ' || TO_CHAR(C.JOIN_APLY_DT, 'MM') || '월 ' || TO_CHAR(C.JOIN_APLY_DT, 'DD') || '일' AS JOIN_APLY_DT,
SUBSTR(C.JOIN_APRV_YMD, 1, 4) || '년 ' || SUBSTR(C.JOIN_APRV_YMD, 5, 2) || '월 ' || SUBSTR(C.JOIN_APRV_YMD, 7, 2) || '일' AS JOIN_APRV_YMD,
C.JOIN_RJCT_CS_CN, C##RG.DEC_B64(D.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT) AS MBL_TELNO_ENCPT
FROM SAA200 C /* 사용자 */ JOIN SCA100 D /* 종사자 */ ON D.ENFSN_NO = C.ENFSN_NO
WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
